courses.name: Seminar Human-Centered Sensing and Digital Health
courses.professor: Prof. Dr. rer. nat. Björn-Peter Krüger
courses.group: Personalized Digital Health and Telemedicine (Uni Bonn, Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences / University Hospital Bonn, Dept. of Epileptology; Institute of Computer Science, Department VIII 'Computational Life & Health')
courses.contents: Master seminar on human-centered sensing and digital health offered by the Personalized Digital Health and Telemedicine group of Prof. Björn Krüger at the University of Bonn. Thematic scope follows the group's research profile: technologies for capturing human data (movement and vital parameters) via wearables and contactless sensing (video, depth and thermal imaging, EMG), and data analysis/machine-learning methods for personalized healthcare, including privacy and security aspects of sensitive health data. Per BASIS (WS 2026/27): 2 SWS, English, organizational intro meeting 06.10.2026 via Zoom; supervised by Anna Jansen, Melissa Steininger and Nazila Ahmadi Daryakenari.
